_comment: QA FLAVOUR ONLY. This file contains NO credentials and NO production configuration.
It describes a Firebase EMULATOR-ONLY project: the 'demo-' prefix makes the project
unreachable upstream by definition, the api_key is a well-formed but meaningless
string, and the project number is all zeros.
WHY IT EXISTS. The Google Services Gradle plugin falls back to a PARENT package when
it cannot find an exact match, so 'com.makanmana.apps.qa' silently resolved to the
production client 'com.makanmana.apps'. That is how the QA flavour ended up inside
the production Firebase project. This file gives the QA package its own, dead,
configuration, so the generated google_app_id / project_id / api_key resources in a
QA build cannot describe production even if every other guard were removed.
